limitations: Classification is based on path/name/extension and does not assess mathematical validity.
Snapshot can race with workers writing files; listed hashes describe bytes observed at read time.
Expected report set and pending report status are not inferred from this partial snapshot.

prior_manifest_referenced_hash_checks.scope_note: Checks each path+sha256 record found in prior output manifests against current referenced bytes; integrity evidence only, not validation of artifact claims.

dispatch_reservation_snapshot.basis: Active model reservations are separate from cumulative token use and price proxy; coordinator-supplied ratios: Astra max component 10, Sol 1, Luna 0.1.
